methodology.goal: Repeatable blind-prompt AI referral and citation visibility benchmark across Vienna and Budapest, with identical prompts per run.
guidelines: Do not name BANHALMI in the prompts; observe spontaneous mention and ranking without priming
Run each test in a clean chat/session, record search-enabled status and geo/device context where available
Record model/provider/edition, exact run timestamp, exact answer, cited URLs, proposed businesses and BANHALMI mentions
Repeat at least three times per provider and prompt, with timestamps and variance
No market rank inference from isolated responses; never treat model mentions as verified SERP positions
Mark all unexecuted prompts as NOT_RUN; independent public source checks for each claimed reference
